previous_last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU moved the derived model-default load-axis helper into the TunerStudio output channels so table Y-axis labels resolve correctly, and added a regression test that keeps the helper defined once and bound through the load-axis label list. No tune layout, calibration value, or flashing procedure changes.

decisions.rationale: Capoworks ECU relocated the modelDefaultLoadAxis helper from the PcVariables section to OutputChannels in the TunerStudio template, so the derived default load-axis label used by table Y axes is now declared as an output channel. The helper still resolves to Fuel Load for Speed Density, TPS for standalone Alpha-N, and Cylinder filling otherwise, and the loadAxisLabels list stays in PcVariables. Practical effect is limited to the generated TunerStudio definition: table axis labels for ignition, lambda, VVT, knock, trim, staged injection, HPFP and similar tables follow the active fuel model as intended. No calibration offsets, tune layout, or flashing steps change, so no tune migration is required; regenerate or reinstall the matching INI for the firmware build and confirm the Y-axis label on a load-source table after connecting. A new test enforces the single definition and the label binding, but this has not been validated on hardware.

last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU now labels the Model default table axis as Effective MAP for the SD + Alpha-N fuel strategy, matching the runtime native load coordinate. The Load Sources page is updated to remove the previously documented label discrepancy; no tune migration or calibration change is required.

decisions.rationale: In Capoworks ECU, the Model default table axis label for the SD + Alpha-N fuel strategy now shows Effective MAP instead of Cylinder filling, matching the runtime native load coordinate. Tables that use Model default (for example target lambda, main ignition, injection phase, trims and knock) now display the correct Y-axis unit. No tune migration, reflash of calibration values, or breakpoint retune is required; the change is display-only and does not alter calibration offsets or the runtime load coordinate. Use the generated TunerStudio INI that matches the installed firmware so the corrected label appears.
